newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end lower, dented by S&P.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end lower, dented by S&P.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures finished lower on Wednesday after a drop in S&P 500 futures intensified a downtrend that had pulled the market down much of the day.
Nikkei 225 March futures ended 225 points lower at 20,610. December was down 230 points to 20,565. Dealers said March had become the lead month on SIMEX as off Friday.
"The Nikkei responded towards the day's end to the drop on the S&P, which pushed it to today's low. Then there was some profit-taking by locals before the close," said a trader.
He said the March Nikkei could fall below key psychological support at 20,500 if the slide on the S&P continued overnight in the United States.

"I'm bearish on this market. It's rebounded nicely from the sharp drop last week but I still think it's overvalued," he said, adding that the March Nikkei showed potential to come of to 19,000 in the longer term.
Opinions were mixed over what triggered the drop in the S&P on Wednesday.
